name: gptragent
description: Work inside an R session you already have open. Biorouter inspects, analyses, plots and fixes objects in memory through gptr, without reloading data. Every call passes gptr's permission settings. Needs R with the gptr package (1.0 or later) and uv.

skills.name: gptr-live-r
skills.description: Work inside the user's live R session through the gptr Agent extension: find the session, look first, never reload, change in place, fix from the traceback, verify.
